task_description.overview: Read seismic waveform data from a remote or local file and export each trace as a MATLAB .mat file for further analysis in MATLAB.
steps: Load seismic waveform data into an ObsPy Stream object using obspy.read().
Iterate over each Trace in the Stream.
For each Trace, extract metadata fields and waveform data.
Build a dictionary containing metadata and the data array.
Save the dictionary to a .mat file using scipy.io.savemat().

task_definition.agent_prompt: Load the seismic waveform file located at {waveform_file_path} using ObsPy. Iterate over each Trace in the resulting Stream, extract its metadata and data array, and save each Trace into a separate MATLAB .mat file named according to the list {result_files}.
